title: Antonello Fratepietro
subtitle: AI Cloud Engineer and Architect | HPC and LLM inference: scientific codes built from source with Spack, GCC, AMD AOCC/AOCL, Intel oneAPI/MKL and MPI, GPU infrastructure on NVIDIA CUDA and AMD ROCm, generative AI on AWS and Google Cloud. Writing about HPC, cloud architecture, inference, GPUs, distributed systems and engineering leadership.

posts.title: Do Jailbreaks Transfer to Fine-Tuned LLMs? Building a Lineage Attack Surface Analyzer
posts.description: LASA (Lineage Attack Surface Analyzer) tests whether jailbreaks found on an open-weight base model carry over to its fine-tunes, and the bugs it caught.

posts.title: One Stage Sets the Pace: Planning Megatron Pipeline Layouts for MoE Models with MTP
posts.description: moe-layout picks a Megatron-LM pipeline layout for MoE models with multi-token prediction from two short profiling runs. On 8x H200 it ran 1.39x faster than Megatron's default split.

posts.title: Rust Inference Engine: How to Run AI Models in Rust
posts.description: What a Rust inference engine does, when to use one, and how ort, Candle, mistral.rs, llama.cpp bindings and Frink compare for LLM, RAG and embedding work.
